title: Cozy Urban Bungalow Next to Everything
description:
This quaint, renovated home built in the 1940s reflects the character of Nashville. With a full kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and huge front porch, you'll feel right at home in our hometown. Plus, it's close to everything!

*This property has a Nashville rental permit.

The space
Our house is designed to give you a place to relax and rest after enjoying our city! As you enter, you may want to stop on the porch for a little reading time on a beautiful day. As you walk through the front door, you'll step into a living area with a big comfy couch and a large flat-screen TV. Then you can choose which bedroom suits you best, a king, queen, or twins, each with quality bedding and mattresses. Regardless of which room you land, there’s a Roku TV in each. If you choose to cook a little in the kitchen, you'll have what you need- pots, pans, utensils, and dishes.

Bedroom 1: King bed
Bedroom 2: Queen bed 
Bedroom 3: 2 Twin beds 
Pack'n'play available 

2 bathrooms

Guest access
You'll have access to the entire house including a full kitchen, eating area, and backyard.

We have a long driveway that accommodates 3-4 cars easily.

Other things to note
Nashville requires rental permits for short-term rental properties. Our home has one so you're staying in an inspected, Nashville-qualified property!
